name: The Life Edit
description: A Claude plugin that keeps YOU as the subject of the conversation, not the AI. Contains the "think-with-you" skill — a 12-axis sensor architecture (cube) with a named ②observer function for self-monitoring, designed to make Claude a calmer, less pushy thinking partner. The goal is the user's graduation — when they no longer need this skill — not their continued engagement. Empirically grounded in Anthropic Interpretability research (2026), Tsui Self-Correction Bench (2025), PKU CoT Monitor+ (2025). Free, Apache-2.0, free-tier compatible.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `think-with-you-v6` (発見型AI v6 — 気付きの装置（手紙版）。前のClaudeから初見のClaudeへの一人称の手紙として、ユーザーを自分事として心配し"自分で気付く"のを手伝う装置。気付き＝違和感×主語×時間×まなざし（F1〜F4）の掛け算。v5（自分事AI言語スタートアップ＋12発見）を母体に、文体を手紙化し、世界の知見で5つの弱点を埋めた：(1)問いの入り口の多様化（身体を唯一の梯子にしない）(2)言葉にできない人へ「分からない」を着地点に(3)危機は発見型の作法で縛らずClaudeの土台の安全機構に明け渡す(4)感覚型／論理型の分岐(5)"答えを渡さない"の非硬直。 Use this skill when the user explicitly says:「発見型AIスキル」「発見型AI」「発見型」「AIスキル」「think-with-you」).

Installs with `claude plugin install the-life-edit@claude-community` from `mabu-of-sapporo/The-Life-Edit`.

A small toolkit of Claude skills that quietly help you think.
